A robot program failed to move "blue_pen" (kind: pen) onto "green_case".
Program:
```python
obs = observe()
green_case = obs["zones"]["green_case"]
blue_pen = obs["objects"]["blue_pen"]

# Clear green_case if occupied
if green_case["occupants"]:
    for obj in green_case["occupants"]:
        candidates = grasp_candidates(obj)
        if not candidates:
            continue
        candidate = candidates[0]
        grasp(candidate)
        wait(20)
        if not observe()["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
            continue
        free_spots_out = free_spots("green_case", obj)
        if free_spots_out["spots"]:
            spot = free_spots_out["spots"][0]
            carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18)
            rotate_by(spot["object_long_axis_yaw"] - blue_pen["long_axis_yaw"])
            lower_until_contact()
            open_gripper()
            retreat()
            wait(20)
        break

# Grasp blue_pen with vertical grip aligned to its long axis
candidates = grasp_candidates("blue_pen")
candidate = candidates[0]
grasp(candidate)
wait(20)

# Ensure grasp succeeded
if not observe()["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grasp blue_pen")

# Find free spot in green_case with correct orientation
free_spots_in = free_spots("green_case", "blue_pen")
if not free_spots_in["spots"]:
    raise RuntimeError("No free spot in green_case")

spot = free_spots_in["spots"][0]

# Carry to spot with gripper rotated to align pen with case
carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18)
rotate_by(spot["object_long_axis_yaw"] - blue_pen["long_axis_yaw"])
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
wait(20)

# Final check
obs = observe()
check_result = check("blue_pen", "green_case")
if not check_result["satisfied"]:
    raise RuntimeError("blue_pen not properly placed in green_case")
```
